zh.title: 发布状态
items: 这是 **0.1.0-rc.3 发布候选版**；正式通道仍为 0.0.18。它包含此前 RC 的机器人、并行任务、目标、记忆、TUI、远程入口和诊断能力。
开发者继续验证安装包，负责人全面测试并连续日用七天后决定正式发布。未宣布所有平台和渠道已验收。

zh.title: 本次修复
items: 修复打开应用和切换机器人时反复读取旧计划对应完整对话的问题，减少主进程阻塞；这也避免本轮启动阻塞导致网络子进程连接超时、随后持续出现 net::ERR_FAILED。
成功调用 post_reply 后沿真实工具结果结束模型回合，避免已回复却再次请求模型并误报空响应；桌面和终端宿主使用同一终结事实。失败、拒绝和取消保持失败路径。
独立核验可读取已经发生的本地计划批准事实，减少已批准任务因缺失历史而被误拒绝。
机器人侧栏恢复版本、更新状态及“更新与关于”入口；两个设置入口的通道显示同步。

zh.title: 升级
items: 旧 Beta/RC 的自动更新发现仍会跳过 RC，且部分版本可能提示旧 Beta 降级。**本次请从此 Release 下载对应平台安装包，退出应用后手动安装**；不要接受旧 Beta 降级提示。
升级前备份完整数据根。同步升级 Desktop、CLI/TUI 和 Gateway；旧 TUI 不理解新租约，退出旧宿主后再运行新版本。
历史会话、机器人身份、头像、记忆和目标保留；设置 → 通用 → 界面可以回到经典界面。
macOS CLI 使用同次签名 Desktop 构建的凭据助手。正式 RC1/RC2 的 tag 和资产不变。

zh.title: 验证范围与限制
items: 源码已复现并修复启动阻塞，以及 GPT-6.1 Sol 成功工具回复后的空响应误报；最终发布包另行验证，HTTP200 本身不算对话成功。
全量回归、两平台 CI、21 项升级矩阵、原生窗口、发布签名与实际模型执行分别记录；受控更新矩阵不替代真实旧更新器发现测试。
远程入口仍仅文本，电脑须在线，批准在本地处理；实体手机、生产 OIDC/CI 账户、Windows/Linux 交互安装与七天日用由相应环境验收。
隔离写任务需要 Git；外部副作用须授权；目标 token 硬限尚未实现并拒绝配置。上传头像为静态图片，默认 SVG 头像支持状态动效。

en.title: Release status
items: This is **0.1.0-rc.3**, a release candidate. Stable remains 0.0.18. It includes the bots, parallel tasks, objectives, memory, TUI, remote surfaces and diagnostics from previous candidates.
Installed-client validation continues before comprehensive owner testing and seven days of daily use. Acceptance on every platform and provider is not claimed.

en.title: Fixes
items: Avoid repeated reads of complete conversations for old plans during startup and bot switching. This reduces main-process blocking and prevents the observed startup connection timeout that left the network process returning net::ERR_FAILED.

End model rounds through actual tool-result control after successful post_reply, avoiding a redundant model request and a false empty-response error. Desktop and terminal hosts consume the same fact. Failure, denial and cancellation retain their failure paths.
Independent verification can read actual local plan approval facts, avoiding rejection due to missing approval history.
Restore version, update status and Update & About in the bot sidebar; channel preferences remain synchronized across both settings entrances.

en.title: Upgrade
items: Automatic discovery in older Beta/RC clients still skips RC tags, and some clients may offer an older Beta downgrade. **Download the installer for your platform from this Release and install manually after quitting the app.** Decline older Beta downgrade prompts.
Back up the full data root. Upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway together; quit older hosts before running the new version because older TUI clients do not understand the new lease.
Conversations, bot identities, avatars, memory and objectives remain. Settings → General → Interface can restore classic chat.
macOS CLI uses the signed credential helper from the same Desktop build. Published RC1/RC2 tags and assets remain unchanged.

en.title: Validation scope and limits
items: Source tests reproduced and repaired startup blocking and the false empty-response error after successful GPT-6.1 Sol tool replies. Released binaries receive separate validation; HTTP200 alone is not a successful conversation.

Full regression, both CI platforms, 21 upgrade matrix rows, native windows, release trust and actual model execution have separate records. Controlled updater rows do not replace actual old-provider discovery tests.

Remote input remains text only, with the computer online and approvals handled locally. Physical phones, production OIDC/CI accounts, interactive Windows/Linux installation and seven-day daily use require their corresponding environments.
Isolated writes require Git; external side effects require authorization. Objective token hard limits remain rejected. Uploaded avatars are static; default SVG avatars animate by state.
